text:
Jordan Lee: Hey team — trying to finish my first-week checklist and hit a 403 when opening Redwood Console (prod). Not sure if I need a service account or extra proxy rules. 
Jordan Lee: Steps I did: signed in via SSO, clicked 'Open Console', see a blank page then an error. 
Jordan Lee: From devtools: GET https://console.redwood.internal/api/flags 403 Forbidden
Jordan Lee: curl output:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://console.redwood.internal/api/flags
# {"error":"forbidden","message":"Access denied: missing_console_role"}
```
Jordan Lee: Who do I ping to get the console role or a service account for local CI? Also do I need to be on VPN / IP allowlist? 
Marina Patel: @Jordan Lee welcome! :wave: For prod Console access we normally give people the "console-read" role first, then add admin perms after a short onboarding. I can file the access request for you — can you paste your SSO email here? 
Jordan Lee: jordan.lee@redwood.ai — thanks. 
Marina Patel: Cool. I submitted a JIT request ticket (ENG-ACCESS-9123). It includes instructions for validating your session. You should get an email prompt to approve elevated perms in ~2m. 
Sam R.: Quick note — if you're behind a corporate proxy you may also need the HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY vars set. For prod UI the platform also expects the session cookie from SSO; service accounts are only used for CI/automation, not interactive Console. 
Jordan Lee: Got it — I'm on my home network, not VPN. Does prod Console require VPN? 
Tia (Security): Hi @Jordan Lee — prod Console doesn't strictly require VPN if your account has the right role, but some customers' private deployments do. For Redwood internal prod we have an IP allowlist for certain maintenance endpoints; the main UI should work over SSO. If your JIT request is rejected I'll open a secondary flow to add your IP. 
Onboarding Bot: Your access request ENG-ACCESS-9123 was created by Marina Patel and assigned to infra-team. Link: https://redwood.internal/eng/infra/ENG-ACCESS-9123 
Sam R.: If you need a service account for CI, file the template here: https://redwood.internal/onboarding/service-account-template.md — include intended scopes (flags:read, flags:write if needed) and owner. We'll need an infra review for write scopes. 
Jordan Lee: Thanks — I approved the JIT prompt and the ticket moved to 'Approved'. UI loads now, I can see staging flags but prod still shows 403 on flags API. 
Marina Patel: Check that your console role has the correct project scoping. I added you to org:engineering console-read. If prod flags are still 403 ping infra on-call (Sam) and include the request ID from the curl. 
Jordan Lee: Request ID: req_0a9f2c. Adding Sam. 
Sam R.: Looking. Quick workaround: you can use the admin proxy for a session token:
```
ssh -L 9000:console.internal:443 sam@bastion
# then point browser to http://localhost:9000 and re-login
```
Sam R.: I'll follow up in the infra ticket and toggle the allowlist if needed. If you need to toggle a feature flag as part of your onboarding demo, @Marina can grant temporary write access for the demo. 
Marina Patel: Yep — ping me with the flag key and time window, I can create a canary temp role. :white_check_mark: 
Jordan Lee: Awesome, thanks everyone. Will follow up if anything else breaks. 
Tia (Security): One last thing — if you end up needing a service account, include justification and expiration date in the template. Security will auto-approve read-only service accounts with a 90-day expiry. 
Jordan Lee: Noted. Closing loop: prod Console works after JIT approve + Sam toggled allowlist. Thanks all :celebrate:
